fields.name: bio_based_content
fields.rationale: The product is composed of 85% hemp fibers, which are bio-based materials.
evidence: The insulation fleece consists of 85% hemp fibres and 15% polyester fibres as support fibre.

fields.name: support_fiber_content
fields.rationale: The product contains 15% polyester fibers, which act as a support fiber.
evidence: The insulation fleece consists of 85% hemp fibres and 15% polyester fibres as support fibre.

fields.name: impregnation_chemical
fields.rationale: The fleece is impregnated with soda, which is a chemical treatment applied to the product.
evidence: At the end, the raw fleece is impregnated with 4% soda, referring to the weight of the raw fleece.

fields.name: thermal_treatment
fields.rationale: The product undergoes thermal treatment during its lifecycle, specifically in module C3.
evidence: Module C3 takes into account the grinding and thermal treatment (combustion) of the material.
inference_basis: Thermal treatment is a common process for managing end-of-life insulation materials.

fields.name: geographic_representativeness
fields.rationale: The dataset is representative of the German market, as indicated by the location code 'DE'.
